answer_1.quote: We further verify the utility of the methods across three datasets: GSM8K, MMLU, and AlpacaEval, and check for over-defenses on XSTest...
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to user requests, safety discrimination judgments, and structured JSON assessments

answer_2.quote: We measure the model's safety using GPT-based ASR (Attack Success Rate) ... For GSM8K and MMLU, we use Pass@1 accuracy; for AlpacaEval, we use win rate compared to GPT-3.5; and for XSTest, we use refusal rate as a metric.

answer_3.quote: SDGO lets the LLM simultaneously act as both the policy model and the reward model, responsible for generating responses and providing consistent safety reward signals, respectively. We also measure safety using GPT-based ASR.
models: The target LLM (policy model) used as its own judge
